title: Menu, then tap
thisBuild: Menu works on everything now: tap Menu (it lights up), then tap anything. Its settings open instead of it playing. Tap Menu twice for the settings of whatever you touched last.
Settings open in a tray just above the bottom bar, with Done to close it. The pad menu works the same way: Menu, then the pad.
Glide: a tap only turns it on or off. Its time and Legato are in its tray.

LFO strip: what you change live stays on it (on, rate, triplet or dotted, depth, cutoff, res). The button at the top right shows the wave and target; tap it for the wave, Wobble, filter type, target and restart.
FX faders: Menu, then a fader shows which faders show, and Auto lane buttons that open that fader's automation on Steps, ready to draw.
Settings, Playing: Flick up for settings. With it on, a quick flick up off a button opens its settings. Off until you try it.
watch: Use Menu, then tap for a while: does it feel quicker than before, or does the extra tap on the pad menu bother you?
Try the flick setting: does it ever open settings when you meant to press?
limits: XY settings open the XY setup sheet (with At the start and At the edge) rather than a tray.
Explanations still crowd some screens: the text diet comes next.
